sentences.text: Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she had visited Mrs Holloway (Edna) in the summer and wore a green coat.
Edna Holloway (S2) confirmed she remembers the social worker's visit.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she likes the lounge and can see the garden.
Edna Holloway (S2) uses a frame for mobility and requires Joy or another staff member to walk her to the dining room.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated she has been walking Edna since the physio session in September.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated her left hearing aid whistles.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated she does Edna's hair only on Thursdays.
Edna Holloway (S2) expressed a wish to feel safe in her room and wanted Mr Pike kept away from her end.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she would like a room nearer the lounge.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated Room 4 is coming free next week.
Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that on the night of Saturday 14 November, a man (identified as Mr Pike/Arthur Pike) was in her bed under the covers next to her while she was awake.
Edna Holloway (S2) disclosed that the man touched her bottom and front under her nightie.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she told the man to stop and get out, saying it many times.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated the man did not stop immediately but Joy Mensah (S3) arrived afterwards.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she does not sleep well and now keeps the light on.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated this incident was the first time Mr Pike had come into her room.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated she told the manager, Mrs Dobson, on the Monday morning that the incident had occurred.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated the manager (Mrs Dobson) said Mr Pike was confused, went into the wrong room, and it did not need reporting.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated she called Edna Holloway because the manager said not to make a fuss.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she does not want to cause trouble for anybody.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated her daughter Pauline calls every Sunday from Inverness.
Edna Holloway (S2) stated she sold her bungalow and is paying for her own placement.
Edna Holloway (S2) agreed that the social worker (Fiona Grant) should tell her daughter Pauline about the incident.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would raise a safeguarding concern with the council and ask the police to be informed.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would speak to the manager (Mrs Dobson) about why the incident was not reported and ensure the Care Quality Commission is notified.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would ask that Mr Pike has extra checks at night from tonight and a sensor on his door.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would ask Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) to send a copy of the incident book entry by tomorrow.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) agreed to scan the incident book entry in the morning.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would look at moving Edna to Room 4 by Friday.
Senior care worker Joy Mensah (S3) stated she would talk to the deputy about the room.
Social worker Fiona Grant (S1) stated she would return to see Edna Holloway on Thursday 3 December.
Edna Holloway (S2) requested the social worker (Fiona Grant) look at her painting, noting Joy had helped her with it.
